categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies wallet import routines in src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Resolves long-standing issue #27336 by allowing public descriptors to be imported without re-supplying private keys the wallet already possesses. As the author notes, requiring private keys in descriptor imports 'is not ideal as it means exposing private key material,' providing a meaningful user-facing key-hygiene and workflow improvement.
